beamngEarth_devToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: toggle dev overlays
beamngEarth_devToggle.desc: Turns the last-used BeamNG.Earth dev tools preset on (default: LOD), or everything off. Unbound by default.

beamngEarth_wireframe.title: BeamNG.Earth: wireframe view
beamngEarth_wireframe.desc: Shows the world as triangle edges (how the ground, the far terrain and the roads are built), or turns it off again (Ctrl+Alt+W).

beamngEarth_reportNote.title: BeamNG.Earth: report an issue / idea
beamngEarth_reportNote.desc: Captures a screenshot, the location, the performance and your hardware now, and opens a window to describe a map issue, performance issue, bug or idea; saves a ready-to-post GitHub issue (Ctrl+Shift+E).

beamngEarth_reportBench.title: BeamNG.Earth: performance profiler (30 s)
beamngEarth_reportBench.desc: Records 30 s of frame times while you drive, then opens the report window for a performance issue (Ctrl+Shift+Y).

beamngEarth_theDrive.title: BeamNG.Earth: The Drive (through downtown)
beamngEarth_theDrive.desc: Frederick to Castle Rock through Denver Union Station: puts the car in Frederick, sets the GPS and the time of day (BeamNG.Earth settings), and times the run from when you move (Ctrl+Alt+D).

beamngEarth_theDriveI25.title: BeamNG.Earth: The Drive (straight down I-25)
beamngEarth_theDriveI25.desc: Frederick to Castle Rock straight down I-25 (no toll roads): puts the car in Frederick, sets the GPS and the time of day, and times the run (Ctrl+Alt+I).

beamngEarth_autodriveToggle.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.toggleAutodrive() end
beamngEarth_autodriveToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: GPS autodrive on / off
beamngEarth_autodriveToggle.desc: The car drives itself along the GPS route (The Drive or a place picked on the map), or gives you the wheel back (Ctrl+Alt+A).

beamngEarth_goldenHour.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.skyNow('golden') end
beamngEarth_goldenHour.title: BeamNG.Earth: golden hour now
beamngEarth_goldenHour.desc: Sets the clock to 45 minutes before today's sunset where you are (the sky switches to Manual; Real time in the settings goes back) (Ctrl+Alt+G).

beamngEarth_nightNow.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.skyNow('night') end
beamngEarth_nightNow.title: BeamNG.Earth: night now
beamngEarth_nightNow.desc: Sets the clock to 21:30 where you are (the sky switches to Manual; Real time in the settings goes back) (Ctrl+Alt+N).

beamngEarth_snapshot.title: BeamNG.Earth: drive snapshot
beamngEarth_snapshot.desc: Saves a snapshot of this moment while you keep driving: a screenshot, where you are, speed, frame times, the traffic near you and the logs, for the snapshot catalog (tools/snapshots.py). Press again within 8 s to add a note (Ctrl+Alt+S).

beamngEarth_routeLine.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gps') if g then g.toggleRouteLine() end
beamngEarth_routeLine.title: BeamNG.Earth: GPS route line on / off
beamngEarth_routeLine.desc: Hides the GPS route line on the road, or shows it again; the route, the turn arrows, the minimap and the autodrive go on (the game's Options > Gameplay > Navigation > Show Inworld Navigation Groundmarkers) (Ctrl+Alt+V).

beamngEarth_dlaaToggle.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/dlss') if d then d.toggleDlaa() end
beamngEarth_dlaaToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: DLAA on / off
beamngEarth_dlaaToggle.desc: Switches the game's DLSS to native resolution (DLAA: the sharpest DLSS, no upscaling), or back to the render scale and anti-aliasing you had (Options > Graphics). DLSS 5 neural rendering is not in BeamNG; this is the nearest thing it does (Ctrl+Alt+U).

beamngEarth_gfxScaleDown.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.stepScale(-1) end
beamngEarth_gfxScaleDown.title: BeamNG.Earth: render scale down
beamngEarth_gfxScaleDown.desc: Lowers the render scale 5 % (more frames, softer picture), on the game's Options > Graphics resolution scaling (Ctrl+Alt+1).

beamngEarth_gfxScaleUp.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.stepScale(1) end
beamngEarth_gfxScaleUp.title: BeamNG.Earth: render scale up
beamngEarth_gfxScaleUp.desc: Raises the render scale 5 % (sharper, fewer frames); 100 % with DLSS is DLAA (Ctrl+Alt+2).

beamngEarth_gfxSharpDown.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.stepSharpness(-1) end
beamngEarth_gfxSharpDown.title: BeamNG.Earth: sharpening down
beamngEarth_gfxSharpDown.desc: Less of the upscaler's sharpening (DLSS, FSR, XeSS), 10 % a press, down to off (Ctrl+Alt+3).

beamngEarth_gfxSharpUp.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.stepSharpness(1) end
beamngEarth_gfxSharpUp.title: BeamNG.Earth: sharpening up
beamngEarth_gfxSharpUp.desc: More of the upscaler's sharpening (DLSS, FSR, XeSS), 10 % a press (Ctrl+Alt+4).

beamngEarth_gfxAntialias.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.cycleAntialias() end
beamngEarth_gfxAntialias.title: BeamNG.Earth: next anti-aliasing / upscaler
beamngEarth_gfxAntialias.desc: Switches to the next anti-aliasing the game offers here (DLSS, FSR, XeSS, SMAA T2x, SMAA, FXAA), round again after the last (Ctrl+Alt+5).

beamngEarth_gfxMotionBlur.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.togglePostFx('motionBlur') end
beamngEarth_gfxMotionBlur.title: BeamNG.Earth: motion blur on / off
beamngEarth_gfxMotionBlur.desc: Turns the game's motion blur on or off (Ctrl+Alt+6).

beamngEarth_gfxDof.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.togglePostFx('dof') end
beamngEarth_gfxDof.title: BeamNG.Earth: depth of field on / off
beamngEarth_gfxDof.desc: Turns the game's depth of field on or off (Ctrl+Alt+7).

beamngEarth_gfxReflections.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.togglePostFx('ssr') end
beamngEarth_gfxReflections.title: BeamNG.Earth: reflections on / off
beamngEarth_gfxReflections.desc: Turns the game's screen-space reflections on or off (Ctrl+Alt+8).

beamngEarth_gfxAmbientOcclusion.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.togglePostFx('ssao') end
beamngEarth_gfxAmbientOcclusion.title: BeamNG.Earth: ambient occlusion on / off
beamngEarth_gfxAmbientOcclusion.desc: Turns the game's ambient occlusion (SSAO) on or off (Ctrl+Alt+9).

beamngEarth_gfxGraphicsOptions.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.openOptions('graphics') end
beamngEarth_gfxGraphicsOptions.title: BeamNG.Earth: graphics settings
beamngEarth_gfxGraphicsOptions.desc: Opens the game's Options on the Graphics tab (Ctrl+Alt+0).

beamngEarth_gfxOptions.onDown: local g = require('beamngEarth/gfxkeys') if g then g.openOptions() end
beamngEarth_gfxOptions.title: BeamNG.Earth: all settings

beamngEarth_timeForward.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.skyShift(1) end
beamngEarth_timeForward.title: BeamNG.Earth: time +1 hour
beamngEarth_timeForward.desc: Moves the clock an hour on from the time it shows (the sky switches to Manual; Real time in the settings goes back) (Ctrl+Alt+Page Up).

beamngEarth_timeBack.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.skyShift(-1) end
beamngEarth_timeBack.title: BeamNG.Earth: time -1 hour
beamngEarth_timeBack.desc: Moves the clock an hour back from the time it shows (the sky switches to Manual; Real time in the settings goes back) (Ctrl+Alt+Page Down).

beamngEarth_timeForward15.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.skyShift(0.25) end
beamngEarth_timeForward15.title: BeamNG.Earth: time +15 minutes
beamngEarth_timeForward15.desc: Moves the clock 15 minutes on from the time it shows (the sky switches to Manual; Real time in the settings goes back) (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Page Up).

beamngEarth_timeBack15.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.skyShift(-0.25) end
beamngEarth_timeBack15.title: BeamNG.Earth: time -15 minutes
beamngEarth_timeBack15.desc: Moves the clock 15 minutes back from the time it shows (the sky switches to Manual; Real time in the settings goes back) (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Page Down).

beamngEarth_mapToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: world map
beamngEarth_mapToggle.desc: Opens the BeamNG.Earth world map (where you are, saved places, click to teleport), or closes it. In our level the game's map key (M) and the pause menu's Map open it; unbound by default (bind a key here if you like).
